description: Findings the gate accepts today, each with the reason no exact token exists to apply. An entry that stops matching fails the run, so the list shrinks as tokens.map.json grows. A zero (0) is never a finding.

exemptFiles.reason: Forge 2046 direction tables. tokens.ts reads the instrument, chrome and lab tiers from them, so they are token sources.
SVG path data for the drawn glyphs, not style values.

entries.reason: 1 is the identity opacity (fully opaque), not a design value.

packages/media-ui is outside this pass (owned by another change). tokens.map.json has the row (--spacing-fixed-element, 8); media-ui cannot import studio-workspace tokens, so it needs its own token module when it adopts them.
Slide canvas of a 960 x 540 document: a document constant (tokens.map.json class exempt-document-constant), not a UI length.

Offset from a scale step (for example scale.space.inset + 2). tokens.map.json names a calc token for it (--spacing-inset-plus-2 and the like) but tokens[] does not define one, so there is no exact token to apply. It stays an expression of the scale, so density still moves it.
